name: The Margin Path
source:
One evening in October, Asano Meguru, a diligent and rule-abiding high school student, discovers a stone-paved alley on his way home—one he has never seen before. Walking through it takes exactly sixteen minutes.

There, he encounters a mysterious girl in an old-fashioned sailor-style school uniform—Hazama Shiori.

Meanwhile, the disappearance of a junior high school girl two years ago resurfaces, and a quiet transfer student in Meguru's class seems to know more than he lets on.

As Meguru's investigation deepens with each passing day, the alley itself begins to change.

And something about it is terribly wrong.
